optimizedContext.value:
# Change Archive

## Rules
- Canonical: `specd changes archive <name> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--allow-overlap] [--allow-out-of-scope] [--format text|json|toon]`; `specd change archive` is identical compatibility alias.
- `<name>` required. `--skip-hooks`: comma-separated `pre|post|all`; omitted runs both. `--allow-overlap` permits active-spec overlap. `--allow-out-of-scope` skips only `impl.linksInScope`. Format defaults `text`.
- Delegate lifecycle guard entirely to `ArchiveChange.assertArchivable`; accept `archivable` or retry state `archiving`. Other state exits 1 with stderr `error:` naming current state.
- `ArchiveChange` merges spec deltas into canonical specs, moves change to `storage.archivePattern`, records history.
- Default archive effects run `archiving` pre-hooks before modifications and post-hooks afterward. Map `--skip-hooks` to `ArchiveChangeInput` selector set. With `all`, caller owns manual `specd change run-hooks`.
- Text check progress uses generic bus:
  ```text
  <label> (<id>)
    …optional progress…
  ✓ <label>
  ✗ <label>: <reason>
  ```
  Never print `Executing:`. Hook checks appear on same bus as `Running pre hooks`/`Running post hooks`.
- Successful archive with post-hook failures reports them and exits 2.
- Text success prints archive path; when overlap invalidates peers, print `invalidated N overlapping changes:` with each name/spec list; omit when empty.
- JSON/toon success emits progress records then exactly one terminal NDJSON record: `stream:"change-archive"`, `event.type:"complete"`, `event.result:{result:"ok",name,archivePath,invalidatedChanges}`. Never emit second unwrapped result object.
- Missing change, invalid state, merge conflict, or parse failure exits 1 with descriptive error.
- Documentation and agent guidance use plural `specd changes archive`; singular alias remains supported.

## Constraints
- Archive only `archivable` or retry `archiving`.
- Archive path comes from `storage.archivePattern`.
- `--allow-out-of-scope` never bypasses `impl.filesResolved`.
